== Description ==
Players Committee gallery image of [[Han Seeker (V) (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour) (PC Gallery Text)|Han Seeker (V)]], present in the Internet Archive capture of 17 December 2007 at 07:13:37 UTC. It shows the earlier remastered gallery wording recorded on that page. The capture establishes that the image was available by that time, not its first publication day.

== Source and credit ==
* Source: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071217071337id_/http://www.swccgpc.com/cards/v2/ds/hanseeker.gif exact Players Committee gallery capture] (original URL http://www.swccgpc.com/cards/v2/ds/hanseeker.gif). Acquired by a direct read of that archive replay; the GIF is unchanged (350 × 490 pixels, 82,241 bytes, SHA-1 9de4e4ca4e43b1687b69d38a07b655349ccb6401).
* Publisher: the Players Committee (gallery rendering). Original card imagery © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. No individual gallery artist is established by this capture. Fair use: the image identifies the published card on this non-commercial fan wiki.
